title: Recipe card and making diary
subject: Art & Design
unit: Summer 2: Weaving, an American-style snack and Baghdad patterns (Road Trip USA and The Ancient City of Baghdad)
source: Written for art/y4 lesson 11 (Recipe card and making diary (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 11: DT: planning and making an American-style snack. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

checklist: Wash hands and tie back hair
An adult helps with knives and the oven

panels.title: Method
points: Whisk egg, milk and oil, then stir in
Adult bakes at 200 °C (180 °C fan) for 15 to 18 minutes

questions.q: Read the scale: how do you measure 75 g of flour?
questions.a: Put the bowl on the scale, press zero, add flour until it reads 75.

questions.q: Make the snack at home with an adult following the guide (or make it after the lesson if the kitchen is not free); complete the making diary on the pupil PDF and upload a photo of the snack.
questions.a: A finished snack and a completed diary.

questions.q: Stretch: why do we check labels for allergies?
questions.a: Some people are seriously ill from foods like eggs, milk or nuts.
A) wash our hands with soap. Hygiene stops germs spreading.

questions.q: Think again: Cornbread comes from the USA. Why do you think corn became such a popular food there?
questions.a: Corn (maize) grew well in the Americas and was a staple crop for Native American peoples for thousands of years.
